mapper.update: UPDATE payment_operation SET version=#{version},status=#{status},attempts=#{attempts},dispatches=#{dispatches},highest_revision=#{highestRevision},state_json=#{stateJson},updated_at=#{updatedAt},next_attempt_at=#{nextAttemptAt},lease_until=#{leaseUntil} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND input_json=#{inputJson} AND command_digest=#{digest}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM payment_operation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id}
SELECT state_json FROM payment_operation_revision WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND operation_id=#{id} AND version=#{version}

SELECT q.tenant_id,q.id,q.trace_id,a.business_no,s.process_instance_id FROM payment_operation q JOIN payment_authorization auth ON auth.tenant_id=q.tenant_id AND auth.id=q.id LEFT JOIN approval_application a ON a.tenant_id=auth.tenant_id AND a.id=auth.application_id LEFT JOIN approval_submission_round s ON s.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND s.application_id=a.id AND s.round_no=auth.round_no WHERE q.status='SUCCEEDED' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM voucher_preparation v WHERE v.tenant_id=auth.tenant_id AND v.application_id=auth.application_id AND v.round_no=auth.round_no AND v.kind='PAYMENT') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM voucher_operation v WHERE v.tenant_id=auth.tenant_id AND v.application_id=auth.application_id AND v.round_no=auth.round_no AND v.kind='PAYMENT') ORDER BY q.updated_at,q.id LIMIT 10

SELECT q.tenant_id,q.id,q.trace_id,a.business_no,s.process_instance_id FROM payment_operation q LEFT JOIN payment_authorization auth ON auth.tenant_id=q.tenant_id AND auth.id=q.id LEFT JOIN approval_application a ON a.tenant_id=auth.tenant_id AND a.id=auth.application_id LEFT JOIN approval_submission_round s ON s.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND s.application_id=a.id AND s.round_no=auth.round_no WHERE (q.status IN ('QUEUED','UNKNOWN') AND q.next_attempt_at<=#{nextAttemptAt}) OR (q.status IN ('CHECKING','SENDING','QUERYING') AND q.lease_until<=#{leaseUntil}) ORDER BY COALESCE(q.next_attempt_at,q.lease_until),q.created_at,q.id LIMIT 10

SELECT q.tenant_id,q.id,q.trace_id,a.business_no,s.process_instance_id FROM payment_operation q JOIN payment_authorization auth ON auth.tenant_id=q.tenant_id AND auth.id=q.id LEFT JOIN approval_application a ON a.tenant_id=auth.tenant_id AND a.id=auth.application_id LEFT JOIN approval_submission_round s ON s.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND s.application_id=a.id AND s.round_no=auth.round_no WHERE q.status='SUCCEEDED' AND auth.purpose='EMPLOYEE_ADVANCE' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM finance_resource r WHERE r.tenant_id=auth.tenant_id AND r.resource_type='ADVANCE' AND r.id=auth.business_id) ORDER BY q.updated_at,q.id LIMIT 10
SELECT version,state_json FROM payment_operation_revision WHERE tenant_id=#{parameters[0]} AND operation_id=#{parameters[1]} ORDER BY version
